description.en:
Basic Attack

Verina performs up to 5 consecutive attacks with vines, dealing Spectro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Verina consumes STA to charge forward, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Verina consumes STA to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Heavy Attack

Hold Basic Attack to consume STA and perform a mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Verina melakukan hingga 5 serangan beruntun dengan sulur, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Heavy Attack

Verina mengonsumsi STA untuk menerjang ke depan, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Verina mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun di udara, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Heavy Attack

Tahan Basic Attack untuk mengonsumsi STA dan melakukan Plunging Attack di udara, memberikan Spectro DMG.

Dodge Counter

Gunakan Basic Attack setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.

description.en: Verina converges an energy field in front to grow foliage, dealing Spectro DMG within the range.
description.id: Verina memusatkan medan energi di depan untuk menumbuhkan dedaunan, memberikan Spectro DMG dalam jangkauan.

description.en:
Verina nourishes nearby foliage at rapid speed, dealing Spectro DMG while healing all Characters on teams nearby. A Photosynthesis Mark is applied to the target on hit.

Photosynthesis Mark

Whenever a Character on a team nearby performs an attack on targets with a Photosynthesis Mark, Verina performs a Coordinated Attack, dealing Spectro DMG while healing the active Character dealing damage on a team nearby, triggered 1 time per second.
description.id:
Verina menyuburkan dedaunan di sekitar dengan cepat, memberikan Spectro DMG sekaligus menyembuhkan seluruh Karakter pada tim di sekitar. Photosynthesis Mark diterapkan pada target yang terkena.

Photosynthesis Mark

Setiap kali Karakter pada tim di sekitar menyerang target yang memiliki Photosynthesis Mark, Verina melancarkan Coordinated Attack, memberikan Spectro DMG sekaligus menyembuhkan Karakter aktif yang memberikan damage pada tim di sekitar, aktif 1 kali per detik.

description.en: Verina protects a team member from fatal damage and grants a shield with strength equal to 120% of Verina's ATK, lasting for 10s. This can be triggered 1 time every 10 minutes.
description.id: Verina melindungi anggota tim dari damage fatal dan memberikan shield dengan kekuatan sebesar 120% ATK Verina, bertahan selama 10 dtk. Efek ini dapat aktif 1 kali setiap 10 menit.

description.en: When Verina casts Heavy Attack Starflower Blooms, Mid-air Attack Starflower Blooms, Resonance Liberation Arboreal Flourish or Outro Skill Blossom, all team members' ATK are increased by 20% for 20s.
description.id: Saat Verina melancarkan Heavy Attack Starflower Blooms, Mid-air Attack Starflower Blooms, Resonance Liberation Arboreal Flourish, atau Outro Skill Blossom, ATK seluruh anggota tim meningkat sebesar 20% selama 20 dtk.

description.en: Verina attacks the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
description.id: Verina menyerang target, memberikan Spectro DMG.

description.en:
Heavy Attack: Starflower Blooms

When casting Heavy Attack, if Verina carries "Photosynthesis Energy", Verina consumes 1 stack of "Photosynthesis Energy" to recover Concerto Energy and heal all characters on a nearby team.
Heavy Attack: Starflower Blooms deals Spectro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

Mid-air Attack: Starflower Blooms

When casting Mid-air Attack, if Verina carries "Photosynthesis Energy", Verina consumes 1 stack of "Photosynthesis Energy" to recover Concerto Energy and heal all characters on a nearby team.
Mid-air Attack: Starflower Blooms deals Spectro DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.
Verina can cast Mid-air Attack: Starflower Blooms by using Basic Attack after casting Heavy Attack: Starflower Blooms.

Photosynthesis Energy

Verina can hold up to 4 stacks of "Photosynthesis Energy".
Verina obtains 1 stack of "Photosynthesis Energy" for every Basic Attack 5 on hit.
Verina obtains 1 stack of "Photosynthesis Energy" after casting Resonance Skill Botany Experiment.
Verina obtains 1 stack of "Photosynthesis Energy" after casting Intro Skill Verdant Growth.
description.id:
Heavy Attack: Starflower Blooms

Saat melancarkan Heavy Attack, jika Verina memiliki "Photosynthesis Energy", Verina mengonsumsi 1 stack "Photosynthesis Energy" untuk memulihkan Concerto Energy dan menyembuhkan seluruh karakter pada tim di sekitar.
Heavy Attack: Starflower Blooms memberikan Spectro DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.

Mid-air Attack: Starflower Blooms

Saat melancarkan Mid-air Attack, jika Verina memiliki "Photosynthesis Energy", Verina mengonsumsi 1 stack "Photosynthesis Energy" untuk memulihkan Concerto Energy dan menyembuhkan seluruh karakter pada tim di sekitar.
Mid-air Attack: Starflower Blooms memberikan Spectro DMG, dianggap sebagai Basic Attack DMG.
Verina dapat melancarkan Mid-air Attack: Starflower Blooms dengan menggunakan Basic Attack setelah melancarkan Heavy Attack: Starflower Blooms.

Photosynthesis Energy

Verina dapat menyimpan hingga 4 stack "Photosynthesis Energy".
Verina mendapat 1 stack "Photosynthesis Energy" setiap Basic Attack 5 yang mengenai target.
Verina mendapat 1 stack "Photosynthesis Energy" setelah melancarkan Resonance Skill Botany Experiment.
Verina mendapat 1 stack "Photosynthesis Energy" setelah melancarkan Intro Skill Verdant Growth.

description.en: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.
description.id: Berpeluang menghasilkan hidangan spesial saat memasak.

description.en: Heal the incoming Resonator by 19% of Verina's ATK per second for 6s. All Resonators on nearby teams have their DMG Amplified by 15% for 30s.
description.id: Menyembuhkan Resonator yang masuk sebesar 19% ATK Verina per detik selama 6 dtk. Seluruh Resonator pada tim di sekitar mendapat DMG Amplify sebesar 15% selama 30 dtk.

description.en: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
description.id: Saat Off-Tune Level target penuh, Resonator dapat melancarkan Tune Break pada target.

description.en: Outro Skill Blossom grants the next character a continuous Healing effect, recovering HP by 20% of Verina's ATK every 5s for 30s.
description.id: Outro Skill Blossom memberikan efek Healing berkelanjutan kepada karakter berikutnya, memulihkan HP sebesar 20% ATK Verina setiap 5 dtk selama 30 dtk.

description.en: Resonance Skill Botany Experiment additionally grants 1 [Photosynthesis Energy] and 10 Concerto Energy.
description.id: Resonance Skill Botany Experiment juga memberikan 1 [Photosynthesis Energy] dan 10 Concerto Energy.

description.en: Healing of Resonance Liberation's Photosynthesis Mark is increased by 12%.
description.id: Healing dari Photosynthesis Mark milik Resonance Liberation meningkat sebesar 12%.

description.en: Heavy Attack Starflower Blooms, Mid-Air Attack Starflower Blooms, Resonance Liberation Arboreal Flourish and Outro Skill Blossom increases the Spectro DMG Bonus of all team members by 15% for 24s.
description.id: Heavy Attack Starflower Blooms, Mid-Air Attack Starflower Blooms, Resonance Liberation Arboreal Flourish, dan Outro Skill Blossom meningkatkan Spectro DMG Bonus seluruh anggota tim sebesar 15% selama 24 dtk.

description.en: When Verina heals a team member with HP less than 50%, her Healing is increased by 20%.
description.id: Saat Verina menyembuhkan anggota tim dengan HP kurang dari 50%, Healing-nya meningkat sebesar 20%.

description.en: Heavy Attack Starflower Blooms and Mid-air Attack Starflower Blooms deal 20% more DMG. They will trigger Coordinated Attack 1 time and heal all characters nearby. The damage of this Coordinated Attack and the Healing are equal to those of the Resonance Liberation's Photosynthesis Mark.
description.id: Heavy Attack Starflower Blooms dan Mid-air Attack Starflower Blooms memberikan 20% DMG lebih besar. Keduanya akan memicu Coordinated Attack 1 kali dan menyembuhkan seluruh karakter di sekitar. Damage Coordinated Attack ini dan Healing-nya sama dengan Photosynthesis Mark milik Resonance Liberation.
